analyst.summary: Allied Blenders and Distillers is successfully shifting its business mix toward premium spirits, and its flagship premium whisky brand is growing fast, which is genuinely encouraging. However, a one-off cost from packaging and supply-chain disruptions made this quarter's reported profit look worse than the underlying business actually performed. Even so, overall revenue growth remains modest, and the stock's valuation already assumes a lot of future success from the premiumisation strategy, which is why we would not hold this at current levels.
